title: App crashes when tapping Pay Now on checkout screen
body:
## Description
During a recorded session in CartFlow, the user encountered: App crashes when tapping Pay Now on checkout screen.

## Steps to Reproduce
1. Observe UI state: Your cart
2. Observe UI state: Processing payment
3. Observe UI state: App closed unexpectedly

## Expected Behavior
The application should complete the user flow without errors.

## Actual Behavior
The session shows failure indicators including: App closed unexpectedly.

## Environment
- App: CartFlow
- Platform: ios
